description: Governed roles referenced by bindings.procedure.performed_by. Roles, NEVER people — no PII; the id prefix is role_. Seed set; extend via version bump.

governance.rule: performed_by may only reference role keys defined here. New roles require an entry + version bump.

roles.label: QA Intake
roles.definition: Quality staff who receive and log incoming complaints/records.

roles.label: Pharmacovigilance Reviewer
roles.definition: PV staff who assess safety relevance of a complaint or signal.

roles.label: QA Reviewer
roles.definition: Quality reviewer who verifies and approves procedural records.

roles.label: SME Author
roles.definition: Subject-matter expert who authors/validates procedural content (the reconciliation-loop human).
